subject.title: feat(ui): custodian onboarding surface with option cards and first-run handoff

question: Should the Control UI’s successful first-run model setup route users into the new custodian conversation as the default onboarding continuation, including the planned agent-driven structured-input protocol?
rationale: This PR establishes a new user-facing onboarding mode and a sensitive-input conversation boundary; the branch’s tests can verify mechanics but cannot determine whether this is the permanent product journey or its intended secret-handling contract.

options.title: Sponsor the staged custodian handoff
options.body: Confirm `/custodian?onboarding=1` as the first-run continuation, then require redacted real-flow proof and focused owner review of session and sensitive-input behavior before merge.

options.title: Keep the existing post-setup chat journey
options.body: Do not redirect first-run users until the server-side onboarding protocol and its product ownership are ready to land together.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged custodian handoff
recommendation.body: Confirm `/custodian?onboarding=1` as the first-run continuation, then require redacted real-flow proof and focused owner review of session and sensitive-input behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR context identifies this person as the author of the onboarding redesign implementation and its follow-up session-boundary fixes.
